outlets.name: Sapporo Travel (Sapporo City official tourism site)
outlets.credible: Official destination site of the City of Sapporo / Sapporo Tourism Association — the city's tourism body of record.

outlets.name: HOKKAIDO LOVE! — Hokkaido Official Tourism Site (visit-hokkaido.jp)
outlets.credible: Official prefectural tourism site of the Hokkaido Tourism Organization.

outlets.name: Japan National Tourism Organization (japan.travel)
outlets.credible: Japan's national tourism board — national tourism body of record.

outlets.name: japan-guide.com
outlets.credible: Japan's longest-running English travel guide (since 1996), staff-visited and dated attraction pages — the standard reference for visitors.

outlets.name: Hokkaido Digital Museum (hokkaido-digital-museum.jp)
outlets.credible: Prefecture-backed portal of Hokkaido's museums — curated institutional listings, not a directory.

outlets.name: Tokyo Art Beat
outlets.credible: Bilingual Japanese art-media outlet of record (since 2004) covering museums and venues nationwide.

outlets.name: Wikipedia
outlets.credible: Notability + published coordinates for landmarks; corroborating only (never a lone recommender).
